189:t_003:22.en:
$$尸空#keyword$$
「As I thought, that $$スフィア$$ is the only one I have no choice but to hunt...」

189:t_004:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$タケル$$! And everyone on the $$クラッシャー隊$$ too!」

189:t_004:3.en:
$$アキラ$$
「This nasty atmosphere...! So it was because that guy was here!」

189:t_004:4.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Still, we owe that guy a huge debt...!」

189:t_004:5.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「All right...! We'll cover $c and hit that giant weapon!」

189:t_004:7.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「So it's $$サイデリアル$$ reinforcements...!」

189:t_004:8.en:
$$ミカ$$
「Affiliation unknown...! The unit composition is all over the place!」

189:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What's with the makeup of that force!?」

189:t_005:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Captain $$ブライト$$. That force appears to be the unmanned force we encountered on $$翠の地球$$.」

189:t_005:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You're telling me those guys followed us here!?」

189:t_005:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Which organization are they from...! And what is their purpose...!?」

189:t_005:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「They're unmanned units. Asking is a waste of breath.」

189:t_005:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Look, $$タケル$$! The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army and the $$ギシン星$$ combat robots are here too!」

189:t_005:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「I sense a powerful malice beyond those unmanned units...」

189:t_005:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You mean the one controlling them!」

189:t_005:11.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn it! We've got $$サイデリアル$$ here too, and now we have to fight those guys as well!?」

189:t_005:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll fight anyway...! For the sake of peace!」

189:t_005:15.en:
$$尸空#keyword$$
「And they have come as well... This is not bad.」

189:t_006:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Right now, let's focus on intercepting the robot army.」

189:t_007:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units! The operation's time limit hasn't changed!」

189:t_007:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We have 8 minutes left to wipe out the unmanned force!」

189:t_007:4.en:
$n
「Yeah... Neither I nor Earth can afford to get shot down in a place like this...!」

189:t_009:4.en:

189:t_011:4.en:
$n
「Yeah... Neither I nor Earth can afford to get shot down in a place like this...!」

189:t_012:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「The enemy has been completely wiped out. No reinforcements are in sight.」

189:t_012:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We made it in time, somehow.」

189:t_012:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, return to base. We're beginning our atmospheric descent.」

189:t_012:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「We're finally heading down to Earth.」

189:t_012:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And once we've liberated $$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$...」

189:t_012:5.en:
$$シン$$
「We strike the Empire's capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

189:t_012:6.en:
$$アルト$$
(Just hold on, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$. We'll be there soon.)

189:t_012:9.en:
$$タケル$$
(It can't be... Is it $$ズール$$...?)

189:t_013:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I apologize, $$尸空#pilot$$. I must withdraw from here.」

189:t_014:1.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Your own woman just got taken down and you don't even raise an eyebrow!?」

189:t_014:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Doesn't matter! After your adjutant, I'm taking you down!」

189:t_014:4.en:
$$尸空#keyword$$
「Can't you fight unless you psych yourself up like that?」

マーズ.evidence: Roze (189:t_005:7) and Shikuu (189:t_005:13) address Takeru as マーズ, his Godmars alias 'Mars'; not in the glossary sheet

ネオ・アルカトラズ.evidence: already proposed in dlg_2026 slice (prison town in northern Eurasia the unit plans to liberate); not in the glossary sheet

kept_omissions: 189:t_005:9: 'あいつ等を操っている奴' written as 'the one controlling them' (controller unnamed in the scene, gender unknown)
189:t_005:15: '奴等も来ている' written as 'they' (Shikuu's referent, apparently the robot forces Takeru senses malice behind, not stated)
uncertain: 189:t_005:12: 'それでもやるぞ' subject supplied as 'We' (Takeru answering Kappei's complaint); could be 'I'

189:t_005:7/13: マーズ rendered via proposed token $$マーズ$$ = 'Mars' (Takeru's Godmars alias; Roze and Shikuu use it); Shikuu saying it is what makes Setsuko note he 'showed emotion' (t_005:16, 'He' by glossary gender)
189:t_005:5: 宇宙魔王の軍団 uses the #pilot token ('the Space Demon King's army'); 戦闘メカ rendered 'combat robots' to match the earlier ギシン星 row
189:t_012:2: 帰還しろ rendered 'return to base' (destination not stated; carriers/ships vary)
189:t_003:27: 援軍です rendered 'Reinforcements have arrived.' (Al, to Sousuke)
189:t_014:2/t_014:1: 'そういったものではない' rendered 'It's not like that.' (Andy's 自分の女 = Shikoku; Shikuu denies the romantic reading)
189:t_012:0 and others: 無人機 = 'unmanned units' (matches earlier slices); t_005:1 'the unmanned force' for 無人機部隊
